messages.en: I nearly hit a pillar in that car park just now.
Good thing you missed it. Take it slow next time, okay?

senses.en_definition: To take someone or something away and flee, especially by theft or abduction.

collocations.en: drive off in a stolen car

senses.en_definition: To drive a vehicle at speed or make an animal, especially a horse, run.
To escape or flee from danger, confinement, or a similar situation, usually in the phrase melarikan diri.
To turn one's gaze or face away.
To evade a restriction or obligation, such as paying tax.

messages.en: That news report said the suspect's already escaped. Is that true?
No idea. I've only read the headline too. Read the whole thing first—don't just share it straight away.

senses.en_definition: To oppose, resist, or fight against someone or something; to contradict or talk back to someone.
To keep someone company by talking with them.

collocations.en: keep a friend company with a chat
keep a companion company through conversation

senses.en_definition: To compete against, rival, or match someone or something.

messages.en: I raised my voice earlier when Mum told me to come home early. Now she won't talk to me.
Even if you disagree, don't talk back and raise your voice. Talk to her calmly.
Yeah, you're right. I'll apologise first, then explain.
I'm going to visit Lina in hospital this afternoon. Want to come along?
Yeah. Have you checked the visiting hours yet?
